Structural fingerprint of a profile

fingerprint.Rd

Hash the structure of a profiled object: the sorted set of (templated path, kind, dtype, ndim). Sizes and values are excluded, so two datasets with the same structure share a fingerprint, and integer and double storage count as the same type. Parameter values in paths are replaced by their {param} placeholder first.

Usage

fingerprint(
  profile,
  paths = NULL,
  params = NULL,
  scope = if (is.null(paths)) "full" else "paths"
)

Arguments

profile

a giottoProfile

paths

templated paths to restrict the fingerprint to (plus their ancestors). Missing paths are part of the hash. Ignored when scope = "full".

params

named list of bound parameter values, e.g. list(assay = "Xenium"). For scope = "paths" they fill the {param} placeholders of paths. For scope = "full" their values are replaced by placeholders in the profile, as whole path segments or as _/.-delimited tokens (Xenium_nn, FindNeighbors.Xenium.pca); pass only object names there, since a layer name like data would also match meta.data.

scope

"paths" (default when paths is given) or "full"

Value

character, an xxhash64 digest

Examples

p <- profileObject(list(a = list(counts = matrix(1:4, 2))))
fingerprint(p, scope = "full")
fingerprint(p, paths = "a/counts")
